# PersistenceSystem

**Tags:** `world-system`

Defines the authoritative save lifecycle: which directory the world and per-player records live in, how often the server autosaves, how a headless server is asked to shut down cleanly, and how a record is written so a kill mid-write cannot truncate it. The world record holds chunk manifests, stations, and creature state; one record per player holds position, HP, inventory, and technology.

> **Goal:** Ground TheWorldIsPersistent — the world and its players survive a restart, a reconnect, and a kill -TERM

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `serverSaveDir` | string | yes | Directory holding the server world record and one file per player record. |
| `worldFileName` | string | yes | File name (inside serverSaveDir) of the authoritative world record. |
| `playerFilePrefix` | string | yes | Prefix for per-player record files; the player id is appended before the extension. |
| `autosaveIntervalSeconds` | integer | yes | Seconds between authoritative autosaves. Bounds how much world state a hard kill can lose, since a headless server cannot intercept SIGTERM. |
| `shutdownRequestPath` | string | yes | Path polled on the autosave tick; when it exists the server saves and quits cleanly. The headless substitute for a window-close or SIGTERM hook. |
| `atomicWrites` | boolean | yes | Write records through a temp file + rename so a kill during a save cannot leave a truncated record. |

## Behaviors

### `saveWorld`

Write the authoritative world record: chunk manifests, stations, creature state, and the local player id

**Rules:**
- An incremental save merges only the dirty chunk manifests into the existing record
- A full save rewrites every loaded chunk manifest
- The write goes through a temp file and a rename when atomicWrites is set

**Auth:** `maintainer`

### `savePlayer`

Write one player record: position, HP, inventory with per-instance durability, and technology

**Rules:**
- Records are keyed by the server-issued player_id, never by peer_id
- Each record is written whole; a partial write is never visible

**Auth:** `maintainer`

### `loadOnBoot`

Load the world and every player record when the authoritative boot starts

**Rules:**
- Only the authoritative half loads — a client receives state from the host
- A missing world record is not an error; the server boots a fresh world

**Auth:** `maintainer`
